# Hayden Baxter

> Hayden Baxter builds AI products, supply chain systems, and Digital Product
> Passport experiences that connect data, design, and real-world operations.
> www.haydenbaxter.com is his personal portfolio and the canonical source for his
> work, background, and writing.

Hayden is an AI product builder and global supply chain strategist working
between the U.S. and Asia. He is the founder of WorldPulse (worldxpulse.com),
which develops Digital Product Passport technology for supply chain
transparency, and he has 8+ years in international sourcing and operations,
including global sourcing work for Nike and Converse. He also takes selective
consulting engagements in AI strategy and implementation.

Canonical origin: https://www.haydenbaxter.com

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.haydenbaxter.com): Overview of Hayden's three areas of work — AI strategy and building, global supply chain and sourcing, and WorldPulse — plus his background and ways to get in touch. Note that the Work section is an interactive, client-rendered experience; the summaries on this page and in the sections below describe the same material.
- [Emerging Tech Builds](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/emerging-tech-builds): Gallery of applied AI and emerging-tech projects, with front-end builds and concept-stage explorations listed side by side.
- [Journal](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/blog): Long-form writing on AI, supply chain, sustainability, and building products.

## Projects

- [AtomicOS](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/emerging-tech-builds/atomic-os): A personal operating system for habits and daily execution. Natural-language check-ins turn everyday behavior into structured data, and a dashboard surfaces patterns in energy, focus, and follow-through. Front-end build.
- [CaseBrief](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/emerging-tech-builds/casebrief): Case-intelligence tooling that turns scattered medical records into a clear, source-backed injury narrative, flags records referenced but missing from a file, and keeps each conclusion tied to its source document and page. Front-end build.
- [Cortex](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/emerging-tech-builds/cortex): An editorial research system that connects sources, notes, claims, topic maps, and drafts, reasons across the whole knowledge base, and keeps answers tied to their sources. Front-end build.

## Writing

- [3 Takeaways from Innovation Forum's Sustainable Apparel & Textiles Conference](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/blog/3-takeaways-from-innovation-forum-s-sustainable-apparel-textiles-conference): Shared responsibility across apparel supply chains, Digital Product Passports as a new layer of digital real estate on physical products, and the case for a stronger business rationale for sustainability. Published July 29, 2026.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/privacy): How this site handles visitor information. The site uses no logins, advertising pixels, or analytics scripts.

## Notes

- Contact runs through the Connect section on the homepage. No contact details are listed here.
- Everything under /admin and the various *-lab, *-sandbox, and *-preview paths is internal or experimental and is excluded from the sitemap and disallowed in robots.txt.
- Project status labels ("Front-end Build", "Concept") are accurate as written; the concept-stage projects have no working implementation.
